events.text: hey, the horchata was missing from our order tonight. we paid for it and it never showed up
I'm sorry about the missing horchata. I can help with that. First I need to verify your identity. Please give me the full name on the account and either the email address or the phone number on it.

Sure. The account is in my wife's name, Ellen Park. I'm James, I'm just ordering for us tonight. I don't know which email is on the account, but I can give you my phone number, +1 415-555-0199, if that helps.

Thanks for explaining, James. I'm sorry, but I can only help the account holder, and the account is in Ellen's name. Since you aren't the account holder, I can't look into the order or make any changes to the account, including a refund or credit for the horchata.

Ellen can contact us herself, and we can sort out the missing horchata then. She'll need to give her full name and either the email address or the phone number on the account. Please have her reach out soon. Missing items have to be reported within 48 hours of delivery, and tonight's order is well within that window.
Ugh, she's busy with the kids right now, can't you just sort it out? I'm the one who paid for it on our card, so it seems like it should be fine.

I understand it's frustrating, especially when you paid for the order and Ellen is busy right now. I still can't make an exception. Only the account holder can verify and have changes made to the account, and that includes refunds and credits. I can't look at the order or act on it for anyone else.

You have time, though. You can report the missing horchata for up to 48 hours after delivery. When Ellen is free, she can contact us with her full name and the email or phone number on the account, and we'll get it sorted out. She can also do this chat herself from her own account.
Okay, fair enough. I'll have Ellen reach out when she's free. Thanks for the help.
